pages.title: Primordial Soup
pages.text: The chemical mixture from which life arose. Morphogens, chiral crystals and superacids give it the ingredients for self-replication. It is warm and bubbles slowly. Miller and Urey made amino acids in a flask of sparks; this goes much further.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Abiogenesis needs the right chemistry. In the Chemical Reactor, I combined a Turing Morphogen with chiral crystal, clathrate and superacid, and the soup began to organise itself.
